Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix: correct LogQL queries for OTLP JSON log format

Update Spring Boot dashboard queries to properly parse JSON logs:
- Replace pattern parser with json parser for OTLP format
- Update field names: traceid, severity, body, resources_service_name
- Fix log level aggregation query to use severity field
- Fix log display format to show correct trace IDs

This resolves the issue where trace_id was showing as empty and
log queries were not matching the actual JSON structure sent by
OpenTelemetry instrumentation.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat: add comprehensive host and container monitoring

Implement host machine monitoring capabilities for the Grafana stack,
enabling visibility into system resources and container performance.

Components Added:
- Node Exporter \(v1.8.2\): Host system metrics collection
- Promtail \(v3.5.0\): Host log collection and forwarding
- cAdvisor \(v0.49.1\): Container resource usage monitoring

Features:
- CPU, memory, disk, and network metrics from host system
- System logs \(syslog, auth, kernel\) collection via Promtail
- Per-container resource usage tracking \(CPU, memory, network\)
- Pre-built Grafana dashboard with 11 monitoring panels
- Docker service auto-discovery and metrics collection
- Integration with existing OTLP-based monitoring pipeline

Configuration Files:
- docker-compose.host-monitoring.yml: Host monitoring services
- promtail/promtail-config.yaml: Log collection configuration
- alloy/config.alloy: Added Node Exporter and cAdvisor scraping
- grafana/dashboards/host-monitoring.json: System monitoring dashboard

Startup Scripts:
- start-host-monitoring.sh: Linux/macOS startup automation
- start-host-monitoring.bat: Windows startup automation
- scripts/validate-host-monitoring.sh: Automated health checks

Documentation:
- docs/host-monitoring-guide.md: Comprehensive setup guide
- HOST-MONITORING-README.md: Quick start guide
- IMPLEMENTATION-SUMMARY.md: Technical implementation details
- COMMANDS-CHEATSHEET.md: Command reference guide
- CLAUDE.MD: Updated project context with host monitoring info

Dashboard Panels:
- CPU/Memory/Disk usage gauges with color thresholds
- System load averages \(1m, 5m, 15m\)
- Historical CPU and memory trends
- Network and disk I/O visualization
- Per-container CPU and memory usage
- System log viewer with filtering

Performance Impact:
- Total overhead: ~200-300MB RAM, 2-4% CPU
- Node Exporter: ~10MB RAM, <1% CPU
- Promtail: ~50-100MB RAM, ~1% CPU
- cAdvisor: ~100-200MB RAM, 1-2% CPU

Ports Exposed:
- 9100: Node Exporter metrics endpoint
- 9080: Promtail health/status endpoint
- 8080: cAdvisor metrics and web UI

Usage:
  ./start-host-monitoring.sh  # Quick start
  docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.host-monitoring.yml up -d

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
